# GNOME Human Interface Guidelines

> Official GNOME application design principles, UI guidelines, component patterns, and reference materials for GTK and libadwaita applications.

Source: https://developer.gnome.org/hig/
Full documentation: https://github.com/Areo-RGB/transfer/blob/main/llms-full.txt
